domain-willeke.name: willeke.com
domain-willeke.description: allowRelaying=true is safe only because of the relay-guard SieveSystemScript wired to MtaStageRcpt.script -- see stalwart-config/README.md "Split-delivery relay" section before touching either.

route-google-relay.name: google-willeke-com-relay
route-google-relay.description: Relay for @willeke.com mail via Google's SMTP relay, so Google's SPF/DKIM/DMARC for willeke.com apply.

sieve-relay-guard.name: relay-guard
sieve-relay-guard.description: Closes the relay-abuse gap that domain-willeke's allowRelaying=true opens: without this, any unauthenticated sender on :25 could RCPT to a made-up @willeke.com address and have Stalwart forward it out through google-willeke-com-relay using Scott's own smart-host credentials. Rejects RCPT for willeke.com when the address is not a member of the willeke-local-mailboxes MemoryLookupKey list AND the session is unauthenticated. Queries that list rather than hardcoding an address inline, or calling is_local_address(), because Sieve's function set (see stalw.art/docs/sieve/reference) exposes is_local_domain but no address-level directory lookup -- is_local_address only exists in the separate, non-Sieve config-expression engine used by fields like Domain.rewrite, and using it here fails to compile with 'Invalid variable or function name'. Provisioning a new real mailbox on this domain means adding a matching MemoryLookupKey record in the same namespace; this script never needs to change. Google's dual-delivery copy always arrives unauthenticated on :25 addressed to scott@willeke.com, already in the list, so it is unaffected; Scott's own submission traffic on :465 always carries authenticated_as (Stalwart disables SASL on :25 by default, see MtaStageAuth), so it always skips this rule and reaches the relay for any other willeke.com address. Wired via MtaStageRcpt.script. See stalwart-config/README.md "Split-delivery relay" for the full incident and design rationale.

sieve-archive-all.name: archive-all
sieve-archive-all.description: Keep a copy of every delivered message in the account's \Archive mailbox, so deleting from the Inbox -- or iOS purging Trash after seven days -- does not destroy it. Import per account with: require ["include"]; include :global "archive-all";
